svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cast tooling plate 300 x 300 x 12.7 mm, edges square; chamfer 0.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the left and front edges. 144 M6 holes on a 25 mm grid,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: first centres 12.5 mm in: drill 5.0 mm through in a drilling jig,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then tap M6 with a spiral-point tap held square in a tapping guide.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nine dowel bores at 50, 150 and 250 mm both ways (centres of grid

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: squares): drill 7.8 mm, then ream 8 mm H7 through.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four fixing holes 7 mm, 22.5 mm in from the left and right edges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 25 mm in from the front and back edges; counterbore 11 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6.5 mm deep, from the top, for M6 x 20 cap screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; stone the top flat. Mark the top face and the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flush in the worktop pocket, 0.5 mm gap round it, on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: packers; four screws into inserts in the two tile rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: an 8 mm h6 pin slides into every bore; holes on pitch ±0.05.
